title: Legacy-contract iter08/iter16 independent curve replication
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: On 4,096 entirely fresh mirrored pairs per anchor, at least one of the exact frozen iter08 or iter16 policies will reproduce its discovery-panel improvement over untouched Standard10 with a two-candidate Bonferroni 97.5% pooled lower bound above zero, at least 3/4 positive anchor points, and nonnegative pooled points in both candidate seats.
material_change: Do not train or alter weights. Freeze only parent, iter08, and iter16; replay four untouched anchors on new deterministic deal seeds disjoint from discovery, quadrupling pairs per cell to 4,096. Apply a two-candidate multiplicity correction and select at most one checkpoint by highest adjusted lower bound.
baseline: Discovery-only evidence: iter08 +26.8157 bb/100 with 98.75% lower -0.0145; iter16 +30.2183 with lower -0.2125; both positive on 3/4 anchors and neither eligible. Internal proxy evidence is not Slumbot strength.
notes: No optional extension of discovery hands. Seeds begin at 2026090301 and differ for each anchor. No Slumbot unless the full replication gate and independent raw audit pass.
Independent audit verified 12 raw 4096-pair cells, all hashes, common decks within anchor, zero overlap with discovery decks, both-seat recomputation, and exact iter16 selection.

result.summary: Fresh-seed 98,304-hand internal replication rejected iter08 but confirmed exact frozen iter16: +14.9376 bb/100 versus parent across four anchors with two-candidate Bonferroni 97.5% CI [2.3311,27.5441], 3/4 positive anchors, and positive point estimates in both mirrored candidate seats.
result.conclusion: Exact iter16 passes the preregistered independent internal promotion gate with audited raw evidence. The bridge-smoke anchor remains negative, so the result is not universal dominance and internal proxy performance is not external strength. The evidence is sufficient only for a bounded fresh5k Slumbot calibration of this one frozen checkpoint.
result.next_step: Freeze exact SHA256 0b1b58a87637f620ae580754bc940ec7aca246d94762d77717c9b578aac9f290 and run eight independent fresh625 Slumbot sessions through the generic legacy-v4 observation bridge, with raw hand JSONL CI, replay, token/evidence and session-independence audits. Do not continue to 20k unless fresh5k evidence justifies it.
